mechanism: Amphetamine increases dopaminergic and noradrenergic activity while deutetrabenazine depletes monoamines (dopamine, serotonin, norepinephrine), creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects and increasing risk of cardiovascular stress and CNS destabilization.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor closely for reduced efficacy of deutetrabenazine, hypertensive episodes, tachycardia, and psychiatric symptoms; consider alternative treatments for ADHD.
